titleCard.headline: 菜单意图预测
titleCard.lede: 根据指针轨迹，判断你是不是要进子菜单。

closeCard.headline: 说清楚
closeCard.lede: 上一帧指针与子菜单左缘构成走廊。走廊内不切换；纵向即时；越过左缘不再保护，也不画反向三角。判定顶点是上一帧，不是当前指针。

titleCard.headline: Menu intent
titleCard.lede: Guess from the pointer path whether you are heading into the submenu.

closeCard.headline: Say it this way
closeCard.lede: The previous pointer and the submenu’s leading edge form a corridor. Stay inside, do not switch. Vertical moves switch now. Past the leading edge, the corridor ends — no reverse triangle. The test vertex is the previous sample, not the live pointer.
